question: Should this draft land as the combined publisher follow graph, notification, and feed-route stack, or be split/restacked behind the narrower follow API/control/notification PRs first?
rationale: The PR adds durable schema, public authenticated API, notification fanout, and visible UI, and the related draft PRs are not merged yet, so automation cannot choose the permanent product/API boundary.

options.title: Restack and prove combined scope
options.body: Keep the combined scope only after resolving conflicts, reconciling the open follow/feed stack, and adding real browser plus Convex runtime proof.

options.title: Split to feed routes
options.body: Narrow this PR to canonical public feed URLs and leave follow graph plus notification delivery to the earlier draft PRs.

options.title: Pause the stack
options.body: Leave the draft parked until maintainers are ready to sponsor the broader follow/feed product direction.

recommendation.title: Restack and prove combined scope
recommendation.body: Keep the combined scope only after resolving conflicts, reconciling the open follow/feed stack, and adding real browser plus Convex runtime proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The current publisher route, ownerRoute helper, schema, and publish-path history point to this person as the strongest available routing candidate for the scope decision.
